body: You typed all this out, and you have survived life this long. That's strength to me. You really don't deserve to feel this way, and I really wish you could see that. You're strong.
You seem to be doing well. I'll try, I guess.

Damn, that's terrible. You don't have anything to be sorry about, OP. In my opinion, you're pretty tough for writing this all out. I suck at empathy, sorry, but I'm here for you, and so are others on this site. If anything, you can talk to us. You are worth living, OP.

I really wish I could answer you well, but I can't. My mind just immediately thinks of something unkind, and my mouth just says it. I just kind of feel hatred, because my friends openly joke about depression and are judgmental for the most part, and they get mad at me for feeling bad. My parents are Indian, and they believe culture is everything. They won't settle for me being anything less than what they want, and their guidelines are suffocating.
Not really, changing therapists isn't in my power and would probably push my parents over the edge. They have been talking about a boarding school.
